cases.name: roundtrip
exec_argv: import os,subprocess,sys; bb=sys.argv[1]; tmp=sys.argv[2]; comp=sys.argv[3]; os.makedirs(tmp,exist_ok=True); open(os.path.join(tmp,'rt.txt'),'wb').write(b'roundtrip payload\n'); arc=os.path.join(tmp,'rt.tar'+('.gz' if comp=='z' else '.bz2' if comp=='j' else '.xz' if comp=='J' else '.lzma' if comp=='lzma' else '')); cmd=[bb,'tar','-c','-f',arc]; cmd+= ['-'+comp] if comp else []; cmd+=['rt.txt']; subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=tmp,check=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE); r=subprocess.run([bb,'tar','-t','-f',arc],cwd=tmp,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,check=True); os.remove(arc); sys.stdout.buffer.write(r.stdout)

cases.name: cross_binary_create_reference_list
exec_argv: import os,subprocess,sys; bb=sys.argv[1]; tmp=sys.argv[2]; ref=sys.argv[3]; os.makedirs(tmp,exist_ok=True); open(os.path.join(tmp,'rt.txt'),'wb').write(b'cross\n'); subprocess.run([bb,'tar','-c','-f',os.path.join(tmp,'cross.tar'),'rt.txt'],cwd=tmp,check=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE); r=subprocess.run([ref,'tar','-tvf','cross.tar'],cwd=tmp,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE); sys.stdout.buffer.write(b'OK\n' if r.returncode==0 and b'rt.txt' in r.stdout else r.stdout+r.stderr); os.remove(os.path.join(tmp,'cross.tar')); os.remove(os.path.join(tmp,'rt.txt')); sys.exit(0 if r.returncode==0 and b'rt.txt' in r.stdout else 1)

cases.name: mtime_default
exec_argv: import io,tarfile,os,subprocess,sys; bb=sys.argv[1]; tmp=sys.argv[2]; extra=sys.argv[3]; os.makedirs(tmp,exist_ok=True); bi=io.BytesIO(); t=tarfile.open(fileobj=bi,mode='w',format=tarfile.USTAR_FORMAT); ti=tarfile.TarInfo('f'); ti.size=2; ti.mtime=1234567890; t.addfile(ti,io.BytesIO(b'hi')); t.close(); arc=os.path.join(tmp,'a.tar'); open(arc,'wb').write(bi.getvalue()); subprocess.run([bb,'tar','-x','-f',arc]+([extra] if extra else []),cwd=tmp,check=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE); print(os.stat(os.path.join(tmp,'f')).st_mtime==1234567890.0); os.remove(arc); os.remove(os.path.join(tmp,'f'))

cases.name: create_symlink_default
exec_argv: import os,subprocess,sys; bb=sys.argv[1]; tmp=sys.argv[2]; extra=sys.argv[3]; os.makedirs(tmp,exist_ok=True); open(os.path.join(tmp,'target'),'wb').write(b'data'); os.symlink('target',os.path.join(tmp,'link')); cmd=[bb,'tar','-c','-f',os.path.join(tmp,'o.tar')]+([extra] if extra else [])+['link']; subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=tmp,check=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE); r=subprocess.run([bb,'tar','-tvf','o.tar'],cwd=tmp,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,check=True); sys.stdout.buffer.write(r.stdout[:1]+b'\n'); [os.remove(os.path.join(tmp,f)) for f in ['target','link','o.tar']]
